correctness.rationale: The K3 is the intersection of two symmetric hyperplanes inside Sym^4(P1)=P4; discriminant and repeated-root parametrization follow exactly. Four double-double-root quartics plus six distinct ramification parameter cusps saturate the genus-ten delta count. Transposition-fixed diagonal is a connected double cover of P1 with eight simple branch points and genus three; other permutations cannot fix curves by symplectic parity or their squares. Fixed point smoothness, quotient flatness and adjunction supply missing geometric steps. The included checker verifies critical polynomial identities, not the geometric infinity arguments. Risk: earlier equivalent quotient description may exist.

value.rationale: The special symmetric K3 has a natural canonical finite degree-24 permutation quotient. Identifying all six exact ramification components as one distinguished octahedral genus-three hyperelliptic curve gives geometric information about ramification of a prominent maximally symmetric K3 surface beyond general discriminant-node counts; the octahedral group commutes with factor permutations and controls the eight branch points. The explicit plane branch equation connects the quotient to its fixed-locus geometry. This is a complete, motivated classification of a natural divisor, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
